project.name: 时光画廊
project.description: 沉浸式艺术史科普游戏，从《Arts and Ideas》的宏观脉络出发，以第一人称3D画廊串联十二个艺术时期与九十余幅公有领域经典画作。
project.descriptionEn: An immersive art-history gallery in the browser. Following the broad arc of Arts and Ideas, it threads twelve periods of art and more than ninety public-domain masterworks through a first-person 3D exhibition.

coreTexts: Fleming, William & Marien, Mary Warner. Arts and Ideas. Thomson/Wadsworth, later editions.
以艺术形式背后的意识形态、社会背景与时代精神作为分期与叙述框架。
academicReference.note: 本项目为科普教育用途，文本为编者按学术框架撰写的原创简释，不含对原书内容的直接复制。
academicReference.noteEn: This project is intended for education and general interest. All explanatory text is original, written by the editors within an academic framework; it reproduces no passage from the source book.
coreTextsEn: Fleming, William & Marien, Mary Warner. Arts and Ideas. Thomson/Wadsworth, later editions.
Periodisation and narrative follow the ideologies, social conditions and prevailing spirit of the age that underlie artistic form.

periods.name: 古代与中世纪
periods.description: 从洞穴图像、爱琴海与罗马壁画到拜占庭镶嵌和哥特手抄本，艺术首先服务于宇宙观、宗教权威与共同体记忆。
periods.descriptionEn: From cave images and Aegean and Roman wall painting to Byzantine mosaic and Gothic manuscript, art served above all cosmology, religious authority and the memory of a community.

periods.name: 文艺复兴早期
periods.description: 透视、自然观察与人文主义共同出现，绘画从圣像转向可测量的世界，也重新界定人在宇宙中的位置。
periods.descriptionEn: Perspective, direct observation of nature and humanism arrived together. Painting turned from the icon toward a measurable world, and redefined humanity's place within it.

periods.name: 文艺复兴盛期
periods.description: 达·芬奇、拉斐尔与米开朗琪罗把理想人体、古典秩序和科学观察熔铸为高度综合的宏大图景。
periods.descriptionEn: Leonardo, Raphael and Michelangelo fused the ideal body, classical order and scientific observation into a grand and highly synthesised vision.

periods.name: 巴洛克
periods.description: 宗教改革与反宗教改革重塑图像功能，戏剧性光线、动态构图和感官强度成为说服与沉浸的新语言。
periods.descriptionEn: Reformation and Counter-Reformation recast what images were for. Theatrical light, dynamic composition and sensory intensity became a new language of persuasion and immersion.

periods.name: 洛可可与新古典
periods.description: 宫廷趣味转向精致逸乐，随后启蒙运动把艺术重新引向公民德性、古代共和与理性的宏大叙事。
periods.descriptionEn: Court taste turned toward refinement and pleasure, until the Enlightenment redirected art toward civic virtue, the ancient republic and rational grand narrative.

periods.name: 浪漫主义
periods.description: 工业革命与革命年代让个体情感、历史创伤、自然崇高与民族想象成为绘画的中心。
periods.descriptionEn: Industrialisation and an age of revolution placed individual feeling, historical trauma, the sublime in nature and national imagination at the centre of painting.

periods.name: 写实主义
periods.description: 库尔贝与巴比松画家拒绝理想化，把劳动、城市生活和现代经验直接搬上画布，艺术开始成为社会观察。
periods.descriptionEn: Courbet and the painters of Barbizon refused idealisation, carrying labour, city life and modern experience directly onto the canvas. Art became social observation.

periods.name: 印象派
periods.description: 光色科学、铁路与休闲城市生活改变了观看方式，画家记录瞬间氛围，把画布变成光的现场。
periods.descriptionEn: The science of light and colour, the railway and leisured city life changed how people saw. Painters recorded the atmosphere of a moment and made the canvas a site of light.

periods.name: 后印象派与象征主义
periods.description: 塞尚、梵高、高更与修拉从印象派出发，分别走向结构、情感、象征和科学秩序，预示现代艺术的独立。
periods.descriptionEn: Cézanne, Van Gogh, Gauguin and Seurat set out from Impressionism toward structure, emotion, symbol and scientific order respectively, heralding the independence of modern art.

periods.name: 现代主义先锋
periods.description: 野兽派、表现主义、抽象与至上主义宣告形式自治：颜色、线条和构图不再模仿世界，而是创造世界。
periods.descriptionEn: Fauvism, Expressionism, abstraction and Suprematism declared the autonomy of form: colour, line and composition no longer imitated the world but created one.

periods.name: 表现主义与未来主义
periods.description: 战争、都市、机器与精神焦虑推动绘画走向变形与暴力色彩，巴黎画派则以线条和色彩重新定义现代人体。
periods.descriptionEn: War, the metropolis, the machine and spiritual anxiety drove painting toward distortion and violent colour, while the School of Paris redefined the modern figure through line and colour.

periods.name: 美国现代主义与20世纪之路
periods.description: 美国艺术家以精确主义、乡土写实和抽象构成回应工业景观，战后的抽象表现主义与波普艺术继续接续这些现代实验。
periods.nameEn: American Modernism and the Twentieth Century
periods.descriptionEn: American artists answered the industrial landscape with Precisionism, regionalist realism and abstract construction; postwar Abstract Expressionism and Pop continued these modern experiments.

artists.name: 皮耶罗·德拉·弗朗切斯卡
阿尔泰米西娅·真蒂莱斯基

artworks.title: 拉斯科洞穴野牛
artworks.description: 岩壁上的野牛与符号共同构成最早的图像仪式，艺术在此刻已具备记忆、狩猎巫术与集体认同的多重功能。
artworks.descriptionEn: Bison and signs share the rock face in what is already a ritual image: art here carries memory, hunting magic and collective identity at once.

artworks.title: 渔夫壁画
artworks.description: 爱琴海宫殿壁画以流畅线条与明亮色块记录海洋生活，展现出青铜时代贸易社会对自然与身体的从容凝视。
artworks.descriptionEn: Aegean palace frescoes record sea life in flowing line and bright fields of colour, revealing the untroubled gaze a Bronze Age trading society cast on nature and the body.

artworks.title: 秘仪别墅壁画
artworks.titleEn: Frescoes from the Villa of the Mysteries
artworks.description: 庞贝别墅的连续壁画把酒神秘仪演成剧场式图像，展示罗马私人宅邸如何以绘画制造氛围、身份与神圣经验。
artworks.descriptionEn: A continuous frieze in a Pompeian villa stages the Dionysiac mysteries as theatre, showing how Roman domestic painting manufactured atmosphere, status and sacred experience.

artworks.title: 查士丁尼皇帝与随从
artworks.description: 拉文纳圣维塔莱镶嵌画以金底与平面化人物将皇帝和教会并置，图像成为拜占庭神权秩序的视觉宣言。
artworks.descriptionEn: The mosaics of San Vitale in Ravenna set emperor and church side by side on gold ground and flattened figures; the image becomes a visual declaration of Byzantine theocratic order.

artworks.title: 狄奥多拉皇后与随从
artworks.description: 狄奥多拉皇后身披紫袍、手执圣杯，镶嵌画以永恒金色把世俗权力纳入神圣秩序，塑造女性统治者的公共形象。
artworks.descriptionEn: Robed in purple and holding the chalice, Theodora is folded into a sacred order by eternal gold, shaping the public image of a woman ruler.

artworks.title: 十月：播种与卢浮宫
artworks.titleEn: October from Les Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry
artworks.description: 《贝里公爵豪华时祷书》把农事、贵族城堡与月历并置，哥特末期的自然观察和细密叙事在此交汇。
artworks.descriptionEn: The Duke of Berry's book of hours sets farming, aristocratic castle and calendar side by side, where late Gothic observation of nature meets minute narrative.

artworks.title: 哀悼基督
artworks.description: 乔托让圣徒拥有重量、体块与真实悲恸，阿雷纳礼拜堂壁画由此把人性的尊严带进神圣叙事。
artworks.descriptionEn: Giotto gave the saints weight, volume and real grief; the Arena Chapel frescoes thus brought human dignity into sacred narrative.

artworks.title: 阿尔诺菲尼夫妇像
artworks.description: 凸镜、吊灯与精细衣物把婚姻现场变成可验证的见证，凡·艾克以油画技术确立北欧自然主义的高峰。
artworks.descriptionEn: Convex mirror, chandelier and meticulous clothing turn a marriage into verifiable witness; Van Eyck's oil technique marks the summit of Northern naturalism.

artworks.title: 维纳斯的诞生
artworks.description: 人文主义重新召唤古代神话，波提切利以流动线条让美从贝壳中降临，塑造文艺复兴对古典精神的情感想象。
artworks.descriptionEn: Humanism summoned ancient myth again; Botticelli's flowing line brings beauty ashore from the shell, shaping the Renaissance's emotional image of the classical past.

artworks.title: 天使报喜
artworks.description: 柔和光线与纯净建筑把神迹置于日常尺度，安杰利科以谦逊而明亮的色彩让信仰获得可见的和谐。
artworks.descriptionEn: Soft light and pure architecture place the miracle at everyday scale; Angelico's humble, luminous colour gives faith a visible harmony.

artworks.title: 逐出伊甸园
artworks.titleEn: The Expulsion of Adam and Eve from Paradise
artworks.description: 亚当与夏娃不再是程式化圣像，而是承受羞耻与哀痛的肉体，马萨乔用光影和体积打开文艺复兴的人性尺度。
artworks.descriptionEn: Adam and Eve are no longer formulaic icons but flesh enduring shame and grief; Masaccio opens the Renaissance measure of humanity through light and volume.

artworks.title: 基督受洗
artworks.description: 几何秩序与几何透视让神圣事件显得永恒而清晰，皮耶罗以近乎音乐的平衡呈现文艺复兴对理性的信仰。
artworks.descriptionEn: Geometric order and perspective make a sacred event appear eternal and clear; Piero presents the Renaissance faith in reason with almost musical balance.

artworks.title: 蒙娜丽莎
artworks.description: 晕涂法让轮廓融入空气与阴影，蒙娜丽莎的微笑成为现代个体意识最持久的图像谜题。
artworks.descriptionEn: Sfumato dissolves contour into air and shadow; Mona Lisa's smile becomes the most enduring pictorial puzzle of modern individual consciousness.

artworks.title: 最后的晚餐
artworks.description: 达·芬奇把耶稣宣布背叛的瞬间压缩成心理群像，透视会聚于中心，使叙事、科学与戏剧同时成立。
artworks.descriptionEn: Leonardo compresses the instant of betrayal into a psychological ensemble, perspective converging at the centre, so that narrative, science and drama hold at once.

artworks.title: 雅典学院
artworks.description: 柏拉图和亚里士多德在宏伟建筑中辩论，拉斐尔把古典哲学与文艺复兴人文精神铸成理想秩序。
artworks.descriptionEn: Plato and Aristotle debate within a grand architecture; Raphael casts classical philosophy and Renaissance humanism into ideal order.

artworks.title: 创造亚当
artworks.description: 两指将触未触的间隙被画成宇宙起源的悬置瞬间，西斯廷天顶把人体力学提升为神学与哲学的双重证明。
artworks.descriptionEn: The almost-touching gap between two fingers becomes the suspended instant of cosmic origin; the Sistine ceiling raises anatomy to a double proof, theological and philosophical.

artworks.title: 乌尔比诺的维纳斯
artworks.description: 提香让古典女神住进威尼斯贵族卧室，暖色、丝绸与身体共同塑造世俗欲望与绘画感官性的典范。
artworks.descriptionEn: Titian moves the classical goddess into a Venetian noble bedroom; warm colour, silk and body together define a model of worldly desire and painterly sensuality.

artworks.title: 自画像
artworks.description: 丢勒以近乎基督正面的构图凝视观者，北方画家第一次把自身位置提升到近乎神圣创造者。
artworks.descriptionEn: Dürer gazes at the viewer in a composition close to a frontal Christ; for the first time a Northern painter raises his own position to that of near-divine creator.

artworks.title: 暴风雨
artworks.description: 人物、闪电与风景共同构成无法被简单解读的抒情场面，乔尔乔内让绘画脱离文本而拥有自足诗意。
artworks.descriptionEn: Figures, lightning and landscape form a lyrical scene resistant to simple reading; Giorgione frees painting from text into self-sufficient poetry.

artworks.title: 圣马太蒙召
artworks.description: 光线如手指般从右侧切入税吏房间，卡拉瓦乔把神圣召唤放进昏暗日常，以黑暗和真实重构宗教图像。
artworks.descriptionEn: Light enters the tax collector's room from the right like a pointing finger; Caravaggio places divine calling inside dim everyday life, rebuilding religious imagery through darkness and truth.

artworks.title: 朱迪斯斩杀霍洛芬尼斯
artworks.description: 斩首瞬间的血迹、皱纹与喷溅被照得无比刺目，巴洛克艺术以身体暴力的真实唤起强烈精神感受。
artworks.descriptionEn: Blood, wrinkles and spatter at the instant of decapitation are lit with unbearable clarity; Baroque art summons intense spiritual feeling through the truth of bodily violence.

artworks.title: 帕里斯的审判
artworks.description: 鲁本斯以饱满肉体、绸缎和树木把古代神话变成触觉盛宴，巴洛克运动感在画面中持续扩散。
artworks.descriptionEn: Rubens turns ancient myth into a tactile feast of full flesh, satin and trees; Baroque movement keeps spreading across the surface.

artworks.title: 夜巡
artworks.description: 伦勃朗把市民自卫队群像变成正在发生的行动剧场，光、影与运动的交错让集体肖像获得史诗感。
artworks.descriptionEn: Rembrandt turns a civic militia portrait into an action theatre in progress; the interplay of light, shadow and movement gives collective portraiture epic scale.

artworks.title: 戴珍珠耳环的少女
artworks.description: 回眸、珠光与深色背景让日常少女成为永恒凝视，维米尔以光学般的冷静描绘心灵瞬间。
artworks.descriptionEn: The turned glance, pearly highlight and dark ground make an ordinary girl an eternal gaze; Vermeer paints an instant of the mind with optical calm.

artworks.title: 宫娥
artworks.description: 画家、公主、镜中君王与观者互相注视，委拉斯贵支让绘画、权力与观看本身成为画面真正主题。
artworks.descriptionEn: Painter, princess, mirrored king and viewer all watch one another; Velázquez makes painting, power and looking itself the true subject.

artworks.title: 朱迪斯斩杀霍洛芬尼斯
artworks.description: 女性手臂真实发力、肌肉紧绷，真蒂莱斯基以切身经验重写英雄叙事，是巴洛克最具身体性的图像之一。
artworks.descriptionEn: A woman's arms exert real force, muscles taut; Gentileschi rewrites heroic narrative from lived experience, in one of the most physical images of the Baroque.

artworks.title: 舟发西苔岛
artworks.description: 华托创造“雅宴画”，贵族男女在梦幻园林中启程前往爱情岛屿，洛可可艺术以优雅装饰掩饰时光易逝。
artworks.descriptionEn: Watteau invents the fête galante: aristocratic couples set out for the island of love through a dreamlike garden, Rococo elegance masking time's passing.

artworks.title: 秋千
artworks.description: 飞起的粉裙、暗处的情人与灌木间的视线构成一场轻佻游戏，洛可可的感官愉悦达到顶点。
artworks.descriptionEn: A flying pink skirt, a lover in shadow and glances through the shrubs form a flirtatious game; Rococo sensory pleasure reaches its height.

artworks.title: 蓝衣少年
artworks.description: 蓝色缎面与流动笔触让肖像超越身份记录，庚斯博罗把英国贵族肖像提升为优雅而抒情的艺术。
artworks.descriptionEn: Blue satin and flowing brushwork lift portraiture beyond a record of identity; Gainsborough raises the English aristocratic portrait to lyrical art.

artworks.title: 荷拉斯兄弟之誓
artworks.description: 罗马式誓言、立柱与明确光影把公民牺牲变成启蒙道德课，新古典主义为革命年代提供视觉纲领。
artworks.descriptionEn: Roman oath, columns and decisive light turn civic sacrifice into an Enlightenment moral lesson; Neoclassicism supplies the revolutionary age with a visual programme.

artworks.title: 苏格拉底之死
artworks.description: 苏格拉底在牢狱中从容饮下毒酒，大卫以古代哲学家的死亡为理性与原则殉道者立像。
artworks.descriptionEn: Socrates drinks the hemlock calmly in prison; David erects a monument to reason and principle through the death of an ancient philosopher.

artworks.title: 玛丽·安托瓦内特身着素衣
artworks.description: 画家以轻简衣着和自然姿态描绘法国王后，肖像在宫廷规范与个人魅力之间游走，也成为女性艺术家职业身份的见证。
artworks.descriptionEn: The painter depicts the French queen in light dress and natural pose; the portrait moves between court protocol and personal charm, and stands as testimony to a woman artist's professional identity.

artworks.title: 查理四世一家
artworks.description: 戈雅以近乎无情的写实描绘王室，华丽衣饰下露出庸常与脆弱，预示宫廷肖像批判的新阶段。
artworks.descriptionEn: Goya paints the royal family with near-ruthless realism, ordinary and fragile beneath sumptuous dress, heralding a new critical phase in court portraiture.

artworks.title: 美杜莎之筏
artworks.description: 海难幸存者在木筏上挣扎远望，籍里柯把当代政治丑闻画成悲剧纪念碑，浪漫主义以历史现场震撼公众。
artworks.descriptionEn: Shipwreck survivors struggle and scan the horizon on a raft; Géricault turns a contemporary political scandal into a tragic monument, and Romanticism moves the public with a scene from history.

artworks.title: 自由引导人民
artworks.description: 自由女神持旗踏过街垒，德拉克洛瓦把革命能量、女神寓意与具体人物熔成一幅国家象征。
artworks.descriptionEn: Liberty bears the flag over the barricade; Delacroix fuses revolutionary energy, allegorical figure and specific individuals into a national symbol.

artworks.title: 萨达纳帕卢斯之死
artworks.description: 东方暴君在毁灭中纵情凝视混乱，德拉克洛瓦以燃烧般的色彩和堆叠肉体呈现浪漫主义对极限的迷恋。
artworks.descriptionEn: An Eastern tyrant gazes upon the chaos he has ordered; Delacroix presents the Romantic fascination with extremity through burning colour and piled bodies.

artworks.title: 被拖去解体的无畏号
artworks.description: 夕阳、蒸汽与旧战舰共同沉入历史，透纳让工业时代与英雄过去在光色中完成告别。
artworks.descriptionEn: Sunset, steam and an old warship sink into history together; Turner lets the industrial age and a heroic past take leave of each other in light and colour.

artworks.title: 雨、蒸汽与速度
artworks.description: 火车从雨雾中飞驰而出，透纳把速度、空气和光的振动画成浪漫主义对现代性的预感。
artworks.descriptionEn: A train hurtles out of rain and mist; Turner paints speed, air and the vibration of light as Romanticism's premonition of modernity.

artworks.title: 雾海上的旅人
artworks.titleEn: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog
artworks.description: 背对观者的旅人站立于群山云海之上，弗里德里希把个人心灵与自然崇高同时置入无边风景。
artworks.descriptionEn: A traveller stands with his back to us above mountains and clouds; Friedrich places the individual soul and the sublime in nature within one boundless landscape.

artworks.title: 干草车
artworks.description: 云层、水光与乡间车马构成恬静的英国田园，康斯太勃尔以对自然的耐心观察赢得浪漫时代的共鸣。
artworks.descriptionEn: Clouds, water and a country cart make a tranquil English pastoral; Constable's patient observation of nature won the sympathy of the Romantic age.

artworks.title: 奥尔南的葬礼
artworks.description: 乡村葬礼被画成历史画尺度的群像，库尔贝拒绝崇高题材，把普通人的死亡与仪式交给公众凝视。
artworks.descriptionEn: A village funeral is painted at the scale of history painting; Courbet refuses lofty subject matter and gives the death and ritual of ordinary people to public scrutiny.

artworks.title: 拾穗者
artworks.description: 三位农妇在收割后的田地里弯腰拾穗，米勒以纪念碑式构图赋予劳动以尊严和静默。
artworks.descriptionEn: Three peasant women stoop to glean in a harvested field; Millet gives labour dignity and silence through monumental composition.

artworks.title: 晚祷
artworks.description: 暮色中农人放下工具祈祷，米勒把乡村宗教时辰画成现代生活的精神回声。
artworks.descriptionEn: At dusk farmers set down their tools to pray; Millet paints a rural hour of devotion as the spiritual echo of modern life.

artworks.title: 奥林匹亚
artworks.description: 妓女以坦然目光直视观众，马奈以扁平色块和现代题材挑战学院传统，被视为现代绘画的起点之一。
artworks.descriptionEn: A courtesan meets the viewer's gaze without apology; Manet challenges academic tradition through flat colour and modern subject, and is counted among the beginnings of modern painting.

artworks.title: 女神游乐厅的吧台
artworks.description: 女侍、镜中人群与瓶中酒构成城市夜生活的一瞬，马奈以不确定的镜像关系追问现代观看本身。
artworks.descriptionEn: A barmaid, a mirrored crowd and bottles of drink compose one instant of city nightlife; Manet interrogates modern seeing itself through an unsettled mirror relation.

artworks.title: 孟特枫丹的回忆
artworks.description: 银灰色树影与水面让自然风景带上抒情回忆，柯罗连接古典风景与后来的外光写实。
artworks.descriptionEn: Silvery trees and water lend landscape a lyrical memory; Corot links classical landscape to the plein-air realism that followed.

artworks.title: 日出·印象
artworks.description: 勒阿弗尔港口的晨雾、橙日与倒影被快速笔触留在画布，作品名称催生了“印象派”这一标签。
artworks.descriptionEn: Morning mist, an orange sun and reflections in Le Havre harbour are left on canvas in quick strokes; the title gave the Impressionists their name.

artworks.title: 睡莲
artworks.description: 莫奈晚年反复描绘吉维尼池塘，水面、倒影和光线近乎抽象，成为印象派通向现代绘画的桥梁。
artworks.descriptionEn: Monet returned repeatedly to his Giverny pond in later life; water, reflection and light approach abstraction and become a bridge from Impressionism to modern painting.

artworks.title: 鲁昂大教堂：黄昏立面
artworks.description: 同一座哥特立面在不同时刻呈现不同色彩，莫奈证明绘画主题可以是光线本身。
artworks.descriptionEn: The same Gothic facade appears in different colour at different hours; Monet proves that the subject of painting can be light itself.

artworks.title: 煎饼磨坊的舞会
artworks.titleEn: Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette
artworks.description: 阳光穿过树荫落在舞者与酒桌上，雷诺阿用温暖色彩记录巴黎大众娱乐的愉悦瞬间。
artworks.descriptionEn: Sunlight falls through leaves onto dancers and tables; Renoir records a moment of Parisian popular pleasure in warm colour.

artworks.title: 船上的午宴
artworks.description: 朋友、酒杯、果子和塞纳河景色挤满阳台，雷诺阿把印象派的社交欢愉推到顶峰。
artworks.descriptionEn: Friends, glasses, fruit and the Seine crowd a balcony; Renoir brings Impressionist sociability to its peak.

artworks.title: 舞蹈课
artworks.description: 德加以倾斜构图和偶然视角观察芭蕾排练，现代城市身体在严格训练与日常松弛之间显形。
artworks.descriptionEn: Degas observes a ballet rehearsal through a tilted frame and an incidental viewpoint; the modern urban body appears between strict training and everyday ease.

artworks.title: 蒙马特大道之夜
artworks.description: 城市路灯、马车与行人化为跃动的色点，毕沙罗把现代都市节奏纳入印象派的光色实验。
artworks.descriptionEn: Streetlamps, carriages and pedestrians become leaping points of colour; Pissarro draws the rhythm of the modern city into Impressionist experiments in light.

artworks.title: 星月夜
artworks.description: 旋转的星云、明亮月轮与沉睡村庄共同构成内在宇宙，梵高让风景成为灵魂震颤的现场。
artworks.descriptionEn: Swirling nebulae, a bright moon and a sleeping village form an inner cosmos; Van Gogh makes landscape the site of a trembling soul.

artworks.title: 向日葵
artworks.description: 厚涂颜料让向日葵的花瓣如火焰般隆起，梵高以色彩和笔触直接表达生命能量。
artworks.descriptionEn: Thick paint raises sunflower petals like flames; Van Gogh expresses vital energy directly through colour and touch.

artworks.title: 圣维克多山
artworks.description: 塞尚把山、树与房屋拆解为相互呼应的色块结构，被后来艺术家视为通向立体主义的关键起点。
artworks.descriptionEn: Cézanne breaks mountain, trees and houses into a structure of answering colour planes, later seen as a crucial step toward Cubism.

artworks.title: 我们从何处来？我们是谁？我们向何处去？
artworks.titleEn: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?
artworks.description: 高更在塔希提完成巨幅生命寓言，装饰性色彩与原始形象共同追问存在、起源与归宿。
artworks.descriptionEn: Gauguin completed a great allegory of life in Tahiti; decorative colour and primal figures together ask after existence, origin and destination.

artworks.title: 大碗岛的星期天下午
artworks.titleEn: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte
artworks.description: 修拉用科学点彩把巴黎郊游者凝固成静止仪式，印象派的瞬间感觉由此变成结构化的现代秩序。
artworks.descriptionEn: Seurat fixes Parisian day-trippers into a still rite through scientific pointillism, turning the Impressionist instant into structured modern order.

artworks.title: 呐喊
artworks.description: 波浪状的天空与尖叫般的人物把焦虑外化为视觉声波，蒙克使心理状态成为现代艺术的核心题材。
artworks.descriptionEn: A wavy sky and a screaming figure externalise anxiety as visual sound; Munch makes psychological states a central subject of modern art.

artworks.title: 吻
artworks.description: 黄金装饰、镶嵌般的图案与拥吻男女交织，克里姆特以维也纳分离派的装饰语言重塑爱与永恒。
artworks.descriptionEn: Gold ornament, mosaic-like pattern and an embracing couple interweave; Klimt reshapes love and eternity in the decorative language of the Vienna Secession.

artworks.title: 舞蹈
artworks.description: 五位舞者手拉手围成红色圆环，马蒂斯以纯色与简化形体让绘画回归最纯粹的生命节奏。
artworks.descriptionEn: Five dancers join hands in a red ring; Matisse returns painting to the purest rhythm of life through flat colour and simplified form.

artworks.title: 构成第七号
artworks.description: 色彩、线条和形体在画布上如音乐般相互碰撞，康定斯基把抽象绘画提升为内在精神的视觉交响。
artworks.descriptionEn: Colour, line and form collide on the canvas like music; Kandinsky raises abstract painting to a visual symphony of the inner spirit.

artworks.title: 红黄蓝构图
artworks.titleEn: Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow
artworks.description: 黑线、原色与留白构成绝对平衡，蒙德里安以新造型主义把世界简化为普遍性的几何秩序。
artworks.descriptionEn: Black lines, primary colours and white ground form absolute balance; Mondrian reduces the world to a universal geometric order through Neoplasticism.

artworks.title: 黑色正方形
artworks.description: 黑色方块悬浮于白底，马列维奇宣告绘画可以脱离物体与叙事，成为至上主义的零度起点。
artworks.descriptionEn: A black square floats on white; Malevich declares that painting can leave object and narrative behind, becoming the zero point of Suprematism.

artworks.title: 塞内西奥
artworks.description: 圆形、几何块面与色彩拼出半人半面具的脸，克利在理性构成中保留儿童般的直觉和幽默。
artworks.descriptionEn: Circles, geometric facets and colour assemble a half-human, half-mask face; Klee keeps childlike intuition and humour inside rational construction.

artworks.title: 蓝马一号
artworks.description: 蓝马弯曲的轮廓与红色山丘共同呼吸，马尔克用非自然色彩寻找动物与自然的精神本质。
artworks.descriptionEn: A blue horse's curving outline and red hills breathe together; Marc seeks the spiritual essence of animal and nature through unnatural colour.

artworks.title: 柏林街道
artworks.description: 尖角、斜线与刺目色彩让现代都市像欲望剧场，基希纳用表现主义记录柏林街头的眩晕与孤独。
artworks.descriptionEn: Sharp angles, diagonals and glaring colour make the modern city a theatre of desire; Kirchner records the vertigo and loneliness of Berlin streets through Expressionism.

artworks.title: 城市在上升
artworks.description: 马匹、工人与建筑在光线中扩散为连续能量，未来主义把速度、劳动和城市生命画成动态力量。
artworks.descriptionEn: Horses, workers and buildings diffuse into continuous energy in the light; Futurism paints speed, labour and urban life as dynamic force.

artworks.title: 躺卧的裸女
artworks.description: 拉长的身体与暖色轮廓让现代人体充满私密感，莫迪利亚尼把巴黎画派的线条化为优雅沉默。
artworks.descriptionEn: Elongated body and warm contour fill the modern nude with intimacy; Modigliani turns the line of the School of Paris into elegant silence.

artworks.title: 艺术家妻子埃迪特的肖像
artworks.titleEn: Portrait of the Artist's Wife Edith
artworks.description: 瘦削形体、裸露肩膀与注视目光充满紧张，席勒以神经质的线条探索身体、心理与亲密关系。
artworks.descriptionEn: Gaunt form, bare shoulder and fixed gaze are charged with tension; Schiele explores body, psyche and intimacy through nervous line.

artworks.title: 夜
artworks.description: 扭曲室内空间里人物被暴力压缩与拧转，贝克曼以战后画面呈现现代社会的创伤和异化。
artworks.descriptionEn: Figures are violently compressed and wrenched in a distorted interior; Beckmann presents the trauma and alienation of modern society in a postwar image.

artworks.title: 鸣叫机器
artworks.description: 机械线条与鸟形仿佛发出无法听见的鸣叫，克利以精确的荒诞拆解技术时代的生命感。
artworks.descriptionEn: Mechanical lines and bird forms seem to emit an inaudible twittering; Klee dismantles the vitality of a technological age through precise absurdity.

artworks.title: 至上主义构成
artworks.description: 几何形体在浅色空间中漂浮，马列维奇让抽象形状获得宇宙般的失重与自足秩序。
artworks.descriptionEn: Geometric forms float in pale space; Malevich gives abstract shape a cosmic weightlessness and self-sufficient order.

artworks.title: 美国哥特式
artworks.description: 农夫与女儿站在哥特式木屋前，格兰特·伍德以精确写实塑造美国乡村的坚毅与矛盾神话。
artworks.descriptionEn: A farmer and his daughter stand before a Gothic wooden house; Grant Wood shapes the sturdiness and contradiction of the American rural myth in precise realism.

artworks.title: 我看见金色的数字5
artworks.titleEn: I Saw the Figure 5 in Gold
artworks.description: 大写的金色数字5在红黑背景中反复闪回，德穆思把精确主义与城市速度合成视觉诗。
artworks.descriptionEn: A large golden figure 5 flashes repeatedly against red and black; Demuth fuses Precisionism and urban speed into a visual poem.

artworks.title: 德国军官肖像
artworks.description: 军徽、数字与色块拼成抽象纪念像，哈特利把个人哀悼与第一次世界大战记忆藏进军事符号。
artworks.descriptionEn: Military insignia, numbers and colour blocks assemble an abstract memorial; Hartley hides personal mourning and the memory of the First World War inside military signs.

artworks.title: 去钓鱼
artworks.description: 蜿蜒形状与自然色块抽象出湖岸和鱼竿的节奏，德夫证明美国抽象可以来自土地经验而非欧洲理论。
artworks.descriptionEn: Winding shapes and natural colour fields abstract the rhythm of lakeshore and fishing rod; Dove proves American abstraction can grow from the experience of land rather than European theory.

artworks.title: 下曼哈顿
artworks.description: 摩天楼、桥梁与河岸被拆成颤动的线条和色面，马林以水彩的能量回应纽约的垂直焦虑。
artworks.descriptionEn: Skyscrapers, bridges and waterfront are broken into vibrating lines and colour planes; Marin answers New York's vertical anxiety with the energy of watercolour.

artworks.title: 布鲁克林大桥
artworks.description: 钢缆、拱券与灯光化为放射状几何，斯特拉把现代桥梁画成美国工业文明的哥特式圣殿。
artworks.descriptionEn: Cables, arches and lights become radiating geometry; Stella paints the modern bridge as a Gothic cathedral of American industrial civilisation.

artworks.title: 格尔梅罗达教堂
artworks.description: 透明色面与尖塔交叠成光的棱镜，费宁格把哥特结构、立体主义和抒情抽象融合为现代光的建筑。
artworks.descriptionEn: Transparent colour planes and spires overlap into a prism of light; Feininger fuses Gothic structure, Cubism and lyrical abstraction into an architecture of modern light.

artworks.title: 伊苏斯之战马赛克
artworks.description: 罗马马赛克以密集的人物动作、斜向透视与戏剧性瞬间记录亚历山大大帝与大流士三世的交锋，体现古代叙事图像的公共纪念功能。
artworks.descriptionEn: Roman mosaic records the clash of Alexander the Great and Darius III through dense action, oblique perspective and a dramatic instant, embodying the public commemorative function of ancient narrative imagery.

artworks.title: 贝叶挂毯：哈罗德向威廉宣誓
artworks.titleEn: Bayeux Tapestry: Harold's Oath to William
artworks.description: 刺绣长卷把诺曼征服转化为连续叙事，线条化人物、题字与纹样边框构成中世纪的视觉史书。
artworks.descriptionEn: The embroidered strip turns the Norman Conquest into continuous narrative; linear figures, inscriptions and patterned borders form a medieval visual history.

artworks.title: 圣罗马诺之战（伦敦画板）
artworks.titleEn: The Battle of San Romano (London panel)
artworks.description: 乌切洛以几何化的盔甲、枪矛与地面网格组织战争场面，将空间透视转化为近乎抽象的节奏，是早期文艺复兴对秩序与观察力的重要实验。
artworks.descriptionEn: Uccello organises battle through geometric armour, lances and a gridded ground, converting spatial perspective into almost abstract rhythm — a major early Renaissance experiment in order and observation.

artworks.title: 根特祭坛画：神秘羔羊的崇拜
artworks.titleEn: Ghent Altarpiece: Adoration of the Mystic Lamb
artworks.description: 扬·凡·艾克以油彩呈现宝石般的细密光泽，把救赎、朝圣与自然观察纳入宏大的祭坛画体系。
artworks.descriptionEn: Jan van Eyck renders jewel-like detail in oil, gathering redemption, pilgrimage and the observation of nature into a vast altarpiece system.

artworks.title: 多尼圆形画
artworks.description: 米开朗基罗将圣家族置于圆形构图中，通过扭转的人体、雕塑般的体量与冷暖色彩展现盛期文艺复兴对雕塑性与整体秩序的追求。
artworks.descriptionEn: Michelangelo sets the Holy Family in a circular composition, showing the High Renaissance pursuit of sculptural presence and overall order through twisting bodies, modelled volume and warm-cool colour.

artworks.title: 尼古拉斯·杜尔博士的解剖学课
artworks.titleEn: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr Nicolaes Tulp
artworks.description: 伦勃朗以聚光灯般的明暗将解剖演示转化为集体心理叙事，人物注视、手势与光影共同构成荷兰巴洛克群体肖像的经典。
artworks.descriptionEn: Rembrandt turns an anatomy demonstration into collective psychological narrative through spotlight chiaroscuro; gazes, gestures and light together form a classic of Dutch Baroque group portraiture.

artworks.title: 拿破仑一世御座像
artworks.titleEn: Napoleon I on His Imperial Throne
artworks.description: 安格尔以正面、对称的圣像式构图呈现拿破仑的威权姿态，将罗马帝国图像、宫廷仪轨与新古典主义的清晰轮廓叠合为政治神化。
artworks.descriptionEn: Ingres presents Napoleon's authority in a frontal, symmetrical, icon-like composition, layering Roman imperial imagery, court ritual and Neoclassical clarity into political apotheosis.

artworks.title: 1808年5月3日
artworks.description: 戈雅以夜灯下的枪决场面记录战争的残酷，将牺牲者、枪口与地平线组织成道德控诉，开辟浪漫主义历史画中的个体苦难主题。
artworks.descriptionEn: Goya records the cruelty of war in a night-lit execution, arranging victims, muzzles and horizon into a moral indictment and opening the theme of individual suffering in Romantic history painting.

artworks.title: 碎石工
artworks.description: 库尔贝以几乎等身大的构图描绘普通劳动者的身体与劳作，将传统历史画的庄严尺度赋予被忽略的阶级，成为写实主义的宣言性作品。
artworks.descriptionEn: Courbet paints ordinary labourers' bodies and work at nearly life size, granting a neglected class the solemn scale of traditional history painting — a manifesto of Realism.

artworks.title: 劳动
artworks.description: 布朗把筑路工人、劳动者、学者与上流人物并置于现代街头，以拥挤的细节追问劳动与公共道德。
artworks.descriptionEn: Brown places road-menders, labourers, scholars and gentry together in a modern street, questioning labour and public morality through crowded detail.

artworks.title: 草地上的午餐
artworks.description: 马奈借用古典构图却以当代人物与直接平涂打破惯例，将现代生活、裸体传统与公众争议带入画面，为印象派打开新的观看空间。
artworks.descriptionEn: Manet borrows a classical composition yet breaks convention with contemporary figures and direct flat painting, bringing modern life, the nude tradition and public scandal into the picture and opening a new space of seeing for Impressionism.

artworks.title: 沉睡的吉普赛人
artworks.description: 卢梭以清晰的轮廓、静止的月光与不设景深的舞台式空间组织梦幻场景，展现后印象派对主观想象和象征性画面的不同路径。
artworks.descriptionEn: Rousseau organises a dream through clear contour, still moonlight and a stage-like space without depth, showing Post-Impressionism's alternative path into subjective imagination and symbolic image.

artworks.title: 下楼梯的裸女二号（军械库展刊印视图）
artworks.titleEn: Nude Descending a Staircase, No. 2 (Armory Show installation photograph)
artworks.description: 杜尚将连续动作叠合在同一画面中，以空间化的时间问题改写绘画再现方式；1913年军械库展的刊印视图记录了它在现代艺术公众争议中的位置。
artworks.descriptionEn: Duchamp superimposes successive movements in one picture, rewriting pictorial representation through the spatialised problem of time; this 1913 Armory Show installation view records its place in public controversy over modern art.

artworks.title: 我与村庄
artworks.description: 夏加尔以片段化、倒置的村庄记忆组织画面，将童年、幻想与色彩经验并置，体现二十世纪初期绘画中主观心理空间的扩展。
artworks.descriptionEn: Chagall organises the picture through fragmented, inverted village memory, setting childhood, fantasy and colour experience side by side — evidence of the expanding subjective psychological space of early twentieth-century painting.

artworks.title: 低头的自画像
artworks.description: 席勒以紧张轮廓、留白纸面和神经质笔触凝视自身，肖像从传统再现转向主体心理的直接书写。
artworks.descriptionEn: Schiele gazes at himself through tense contour, bare paper and nervous touch; portraiture turns from traditional likeness to a direct writing of the subject's psyche.

artworks.title: 铁道旁的房屋
artworks.description: 霍普以孤立的房屋、静止的轨道与清冷光线构成美国现代生活的情感空间，将日常建筑转化为关于疏离与沉默的象征。
artworks.descriptionEn: Hopper builds an emotional space of American modern life from an isolated house, still tracks and cold light, turning an ordinary building into a symbol of estrangement and silence.
